items.why: Sensor Tower data showed Meta's Muse AI assistant posting 7-day retention near ChatGPT levels, stoking optimism about its consumer AI push. The stock extended its rally on the bullish engagement read.

Reports that OpenAI revenue fell short of expectations rattled AI hardware names, and ARK Invest trimmed its stake after the run to record highs. The stock broke $620 support as chip profit-taking spread.
Geopolitical risk bid up hedges: Houthi strikes on a Saudi airport and Russia-Ukraine energy attacks lifted oil and put Wednesday CPI and the bank earnings slate in sharper focus.

Brent topped $106 after deadly strikes on Riyadh's airport and Russian attacks on Ukrainian energy sites, overriding Trump's announced energy ceasefire. Tanker attacks also pushed freight rates higher.

market_note: Dow futures edge up while Nasdaq futures lag; Treasury market is closed for the holiday.
summary: Stocks are mixed on Columbus Day as semiconductors sell off while energy and select megacaps climb. Oil above $93 and a midweek CPI print are keeping rate risk front and center.
